QuestInfo.name: The Shimmering Bristles of Victory
QuestInfo.0: Go back to Spiegelmann and let him know that his order is on the way.
QuestInfo.1: Spiegelmann wants to be prepared for when his new moustache arrives. Travel to the #e#bQuiet Strolling Path#k#n using the #bWestern Portal#k and recover his Dapper Drip from Water Thief Monsters.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Spiegelmann a good supply of Dapper Drip.

0.0: Did you order my supplies? It's very important. I'm really feeling quite down on myself.
0.1: When is it going to be here? Why isn't it here already?! Oh, whatever. While we're waiting I've got another amazing opportunity just for you!

yes.0: It ain't easy to keep a soup-strainer in tip-top condition. It requires a constant moisturizing regimen using the very best of creams... #rDapper Drip#k! And that means fighting with #bWater Thief Monsters#k that want to steal my stache' stash! That's why I want you to go down to the #bQuiet Strolling Path#k get my moisturizers back!

no.0: Don't act like you've got anything better to do!

1.0: Did you bring the moisturizer? Are my new bristles are destined to dry out!

yes.0: Why, oh why, is my lip still cold? Who could ever love a smooth-faced goblin like me?!

item.0: I'm still waiting! And so is my glorious crumb catcher!
